tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /legs bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer las yan lag rdzas 'gog gi rnam par bshad pa gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shes ldan rnams kyi rna ba'i bdud rtsi'o// mngon brjod rgyan tshig sgrig mkhas sa skya pa/ /'chad mkhas rna ba'i bdud rtsi 'bum phrag gsum/ /rtsod pa'i khyu mchog blo gros rnam rgyal zhabs/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma gsum gyis bdag la srungs/ /yan lag rdzas kyi dam bca' ltar snang gsum/ /'gog byed phyogs kyi glang pos dpe tsam zhig /bstan las chos kyi grags pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /rigs pa'i chu brtags spros de 'dir 'chad do/ /'dis grub ces sogs skabs su gsum las/ dang po la gsum/ bshad bya rdo rje'i mdo tshig 'god/ 'chad byed chos grags gzhung gis bkral/ lha rgyan 'grel pa'i rnam dbye bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo rang 'grel rgyan gyis 'grel pa'i 'gyur ltar na/ 'dis ni chos kyi rang gi ngo bo sel ba'i sgo tsam zhig bstan pa yin no/ /phyogs 'dis ni chos dang chos can gyi khyad par dang / chos can rang gi ngo bo sel ba yang rig par bya ste/ 'di lta ste dper na/ yan lag can ni yan lag rnams las gzhan ma yin te/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par mi 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag rnams ni yan lag can las gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum nyid ma yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rdzas ni yod pa ma yin te/ yon tan dang rdzas dag rdzas dang rdzas ma yin pa nyid du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dam bca' dang po la/ yan lag chos can du bzung zhing / dam bca' gnyis pa la/ yan lag chos can du bzung ba'i 'gyur mdzad do/ /yang mdo rang 'grel lha dbang blo 'grel pa'i 'gyur ltar na/ dam bca' gnyis pa'i tshe/ yan lag dang yan lag can dag ni gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum ma yin par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dam bca' gnyis pa'i chos can du/ yan lag can 'dzin pa'i lugs mdzad do/ /yang mdo rang 'grel gyi 'gyur 'ga' zhig las/

yan lag rnams ni yan lag can las gzhan ma yin te/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag can ni yan lag las gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /rdzas ni yod pa ma yin te/ yon tan dang rdzas dag rdzas dang rdzas ma yin pa nyid du thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes yan lag tu bzung ba dam bca' dang po chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' dang / yan lag can du bzung ba dam bca' gnyis pa chos can gyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bcar bshad pa ste/ mdo rang 'grel gyi 'gyur cung zad mi gcig pa gsum yod la/ de dag gis rim bzhin chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'/ chos can gyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'/ chos can gyi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' gsum shugs la bstan nas/ dam bca' dang po la rjes dpag gi gnod byed dang gnyis pa la mngon sum gyi gnod byed dang / gsum pa la khas blangs kyi gnod byed gsum dngos su bstan te/ gnod byed gzhan rnams mtshon nas bstan pa'i don de dag rnam 'grel 'dir 'chad pa la/ 'dis grub yan lag gyur pa yi zhes pa nas/ dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar shlau ka bcu gsum po 'di byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa mdo'i dgongs pa chos grags kyis bkral tshul la/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po la/ 'dis grub sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ 'di 'bru la sbyar na/ shes bya chos can/ chos kyi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la tshad mas gnod par ma zad/ dam bca' phyi ma gsum gyi zhen don la yang tshad ma bzhis gnod pa yin te/ chos kyi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la tshad mas gnod byed bstan pa 'dis/ bye brag pa'i grub mtha'i yan lag tu gyur pa yi chos can gyi khyad par dang / chos can rang gi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la'ang rjes dpag sogs kyis gnod pa byed tshul dag ni mtshon nas bstan pa yin pa'i phyir zhes 'chad pa la/

'dis grub yan lag gyur pa yis/ /zhes so/ /'di'i 'bru la phal cher bsgrub bya'i yan lag tu gyur pa yi/ zhes 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ 'dis sgrub yan lag gyur pa yi/ /zhes pa'i gzhung yod na khyed bden yang / 'dis grub yan lag gyur pa yi/ /zhes pa las mi 'dug pa'i phyir ro// ༈ gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gnyis/ chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' dgag tshul des phyi ma gnyis kyang mtshon par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang / mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po la/ de la don ni zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis so/ /de 'bru dang sbyar na/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' sogs gsum yod pa de la/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' zhen don la gnod byed kyi dpe ni phyogs brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dam bca' phyi ma gnyis kyi zhen don la yang gnod pa byed tshul gyi don 'di ni mtshon nas bstan pa'i don du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dpe ni phyogs tsam brjod ces pa'i tshig gi rno bya ltar na/ 'di ltar bshad de/ tshad ma mdor/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par mi 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gnod byed kyi dpe ni rjes dpag gi phyogs tsam zhig brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dam bca' gsum yod pa de la ltar snang phyi ma gnyis kyi zhen don la yang / rjes dpag gis gnod pa byed do zhes pa'i don 'di ni shugs la bstan pa yi don du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang tshad ma mdor/ chos can gyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ mngon sum nyid ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro zhes/ gnod byed kyi dpe ni mngon sum gyi phyogs tsam zhig brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dam bca' gsum yod pa de la ltar snang snga phyi gnyis kyi zhen don la yang mngon sum gyis gnod pa byed do zhes pa'i don 'di ni shugs la bstan pa'i don du yin pa'i phyir ro/

/yang tshad ma mdor/ chos can gyi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ yon tan dang rdzas dag rdzas dang rdzas ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro zhes/ gnod byed kyi dpe ni/ khas blangs 'gal ba'i phyogs tsam zhig brjod pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ dam bca' gsum yod pa de la dam bca' snga ma gnyis kyi zhen don la yang / khas blangs 'gal bas gnod pa byed do zhes pa'i don 'di ni shugs la bstan pa'i don du yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ de la don ni bstan pa yi/ /don du dpe ni phyogs tsam brjod/ /ces so/ /phyogs glang grags pa'i dgongs dbyings rdzogs par gyur cig 'di ni kho bos rtogs so/ /gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bzhi/ gnod bya'i dam bca' ngos kyis bzung / /thal rang rigs pa'i phreng ba 'phangs/ /rang tshig khas blangs nang 'gal bstan/ /mngon sum tshad mas bsal ba phab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ldan don sogs tshigs bcad gnyis so/ /de 'bru dang sbyar na/ sngar rgol bye brag pas/ phyir rgol sangs rgyas pa'i ngor/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'i zhe 'dod dam 'cha' tshul yod de/ rigs mthun gyi rdul phran gnyis yan chad ldan pa ste phrad pa'i don khyad gzhi yan lag can de/ khyad chos yon tan lcid lhag dang / 'bras bu thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba dang / de gnyis gzhi gcig la 'phrod pa 'du ba'i rgyu byed pa'i rdzas kyi mtshan nyid gsum kyis khyad par du byas pa can/ mthong ba la brten pa ste mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi yan lag can de/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du yod pa yin no/ /zhes dam bca' ba yin pa'i phyir te/ mngon sum gyis ma mthong ba'i yan lag can rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bca' ba la/ sngar rgol bye brag pa rang gi zhe 'dod 'grub pa'i dgos pa med/ lcid sogs chos gsum gyi khyad par du byas pa can ma yin pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las gzhan du dam bca' ba la/

phyir rgol sangs rgyas pas shes 'dod 'jug pa'i dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ ldan don rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can/ /mthong ba la brten gzhan yod yin/ /ma mthong khyad par can min pa/ /dam bca' ba la dgos pa med/ /ces so/ /rtags de gnyis bsgrub pa la/ rtags dang po grub ste/ mngon sum gyis ma mthong ba'i yan lag can dang po lta bu la/ 'bras bu lci sogs dang sgrib thogs kyi bya ba med par mthong nas/ lcid sogs dang sgrib thogs kyi bya ba byed pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du bsgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ lcid sogs chos gsum kyis khyad par du byas pa can ma yin pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du 'dod pa tsam ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i ngor sgrub na grub zin pa grub pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ de tsam zhig sangs rgyas pas kyang khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ ma mthong ba la 'bras med pa/ /mthong nas yan lag can sgrub 'dod/ /khyad par can min gzhan yod min/ /sgrub na grub pa sgrub pa nyid/ /ces so/ /des na gzhung 'dis dngos bstan dam bca' dang po kho na yin kyang / shugs bstan dam bca' phyi ma gnyis kyang bstan te/ ldan don rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can/ /zhes pa des/ rdzas kyi mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i yan lag can yod do zhes/ chos can gyi ngo bo bsgrub pa'i dam bca' bstan/ mthong ba la brten gzhan yod min/ /zhes pa des/ mngon sum kyis mthong ba'i yan lag de/ yan lag can las rdzas gzhan min/ /zhes/ chos can gyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' de shugs la bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa thal rang rigs pa'i phreng ba 'phangs pa la gsum/ log rtog zlog byed thal 'gyur 'phangs/ rjes dpag skyed byed rang rgyud bkod pa/ de ltar bkod pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gal te 'di lci sogs tshig rkang gnyis so/ /de 'bru la sbyar na gal te bye brag pa khyod kyi lugs kyi yan lag can 'di la/

yon tan lcid lhag pa dang / de'i 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i bya ba gnyis dang ldan par khas len na/ lcid mnyam gyi 'jim ril bcu tshan gnyis las bsdoms pa'i 'jim ril chos can/ khyod ma bsdoms pa'i ril gnyis srang la gzhal ba'i tshe/ khyod 'jal byed kyi srang mgo ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur bar thal/ khyed gnyis la yan lag gi lcid mnyam por yod pa gang zhig khyod la yon tan lcid lhag skyes/ gcig shos la ma skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ gal te 'di lci 'og 'gror 'gyur/ /srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di'i 'bru non du/ kha cig khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i lcid lhag gi 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba dang / khyod kyi lcid lhag 'jal ba'i srang mgo dma' ba nyid du 'gyur bar thal/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i lcid lhag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes/ 'di lci 'og 'gror zhes pa tshad bsal du 'phen pa ni/ cung mi 'thad de/ thal ba de bye brag pa la bsal ba ye med yin pa'i phyir te/ lcid lhag gi 'bras bus 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba de/ lcid sogs chos gsum gyi nang tshan yin pas/ rgol ba des 'dod lan thebs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig lcid sogs chos gsum 'dren pa'i tshe/ yon tan lcid lhag dang / de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba dang / de gnyis gzhi gcig la 'phrod pa 'du ba'i rgyu byed pa zhes 'chad pa'ang mi 'thad de/ khos lcid sogs chos gsum khas blangs pa la/ lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba yod par thal/ yon tan lcid lhag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /kho la mi 'dod pa thal bar 'phen pa yin gyi/ kho'i rtsa ba'i grub mtha' la de lta bu khas blangs pa med pa'i phyir dang / gal te khas blangs nas/ srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur zhes/ thal ba 'phangs pa la dgos pa med de/ khos 'dod lan thebs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung 'di la mkhas grub rje'i ṭīkkar 'di skad ces/

'jim ril lnga bsres pa'i gong bu 'di chos can/ khyod ma bsres pa'i 'jim ril lnga la med pa'i 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba don gzhan dang ldan par 'gyur bar thal/ de dag la med pa'i lcid kyi yon tan lhag po yod pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags khas/ 'dod na/ 'jim ril bong tshod mnyam po bcu tshan gcig las lnga ma bsres shing lnga bsres nas srang la bcal ba na/ phyi ma nyid srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur bar thal/ sngar ma bsres pa'i tshe lcid mnyam du yod pa gang zhig bsres pa na phyi ma la yan lag can gyi lcid des drangs pa'i 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba lhag po yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mngon sum tshad mas bsal zhes 'chad mod/ cung zad gnad ma dgongs pa snga ma dang 'dra ste/ khyed rang gi thal ba snga ma de'i rtags kho la dngos 'gal yin na/ khos rig pa yan lag can la lcid sogs chos gsum 'brel med du khas blangs pas/ bsal ba de ltar 'phen pa ngal ba 'bras med yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na khyed kyi lugs la/ gal te 'di lci zhes pa rtags su bkod/ 'og 'gror 'gyur zhes pa gsal bar 'phangs/ de la 'dod lan 'debs na/ srang ni dma' ba dag du 'gyur gyi thal ba 'phen zhes pa snying por gnang yang / rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ma yin te/ 'di lci 'og 'gror zhes pa/ khas blangs rtags su bkod nas/ srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur/ mi 'dod pa thal bar 'phen pa'i gzhung yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na snying po gzhi gcig la dper mtshon na/ yan lag can bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i lcid lhag 'jal ba'i srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur bar thal/ khyod rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lcid lhag dang / des drangs pa'i 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis dang ldan pa de yin pa'i phyir/ kho la rtags dngos/ rang nyid kyi rtags de 'dra nam du yang khas mi len no zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin no/ /gnyis pa rjes dpag skyed byed rang rgyud 'chad pa la/

des na yon tan bya med pa/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig go /de 'bru la sbyar na gong gi thal ba la brten nas/ log rtog gi dbal cung zad gzhom pa na/ yan lag can bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lcid lhag dang / de'i 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis med pa yin te/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i lcid lhag 'jal ba'i srang mgo dma' ba de med pa des phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ des na yon tan bya med pa zhes so/ /des na yan lag can bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lcid lhag dang / des drangs pa'i 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis gzhi gcig la 'phrod pa 'du ba can gyi rgyu byed pa de yang yod pa min te/ khyod la lcid lhag dang bya ba de gnyis med pa de'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ de phyir 'du ba can rgyu min/ /zhes sogs/ de ltar gong gi thal bas log rtog log tshul tshad ma des/ bsgrub bya la shes 'dod the tshom dang ldan pa'i bye brag pa'i rigs rgyud gcig la rtags 'di ltar 'god de/ yan lag can bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lcid lhag de mthong ba med de/ khyod la lcid lhag de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba de mthong ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i rtags dang / yang de chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lcid lhag de mthong ba med de/ khyod la lcid lhag de'i ngo bo dag tshad mas mthong ba med pa ste ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags gang rung 'god pas/ yan lag can de la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i lcid lhag med par mthong ba'i rtags can rjes dpag skye ba yin te/ rgol ba de la de bkod pa skabs su bab pa de'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ de phyir 'bras bu ngo bo dag /mthong ba med phyir de mthong min/

/zhes so/ /gsum pa de ltar bkod pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa ni/ des na med na mi 'byung ba/ /sogs rkang pa gcig go /de 'bru la sbyar na/ bshad zin pa des na/ tshad ma mdor/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'i zhen don la gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rigs pa 'dis/ khyad chos lcid lhag de bkag pas/ chos gsum ldan gyi khyad gzhi yan lag can dang / khyad par gyi chos gzhan lcid kyi 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba dang / de gnyis 'phrod pa 'du ba'i rgyu byed pa gnyis la yang shugs la gnod pa bstan pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir te/ yon tan lcid lhag khegs pas/ 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba khegs/ de bkag pas 'phrod 'du ba'i 'brel ba khegs/ khyad chos de gsum bkag pas/ khyad chos de gsum dang ldan pa'i khyad gzhi yan lag can de yang khegs pa'i phyir te/ khyod kyi lugs la yon tan lcid lhag de/ de rnams med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ des na med na mi 'byung ba/ /khyad par gzhan la gnod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /shes ldan dag gis dga' ston gyis shig gsum pa rang tshig khas blangs nang 'gal bstan pa la bzhi/ dpe don bsal ba'i phyogs snga bkod/ don la nang 'gal byung bas dgag de la chos mthun med pas dgag 'phros don yon tan lhag po dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phra mo nas tsam sogs tshigs bcad gcig go /de 'bru la sbyar na/ snga rgol bye brag pa gzhan dag na re/ gal te 'di lci 'og 'gror 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rtsa ba'i thal 'gyur la khyab pa med de/ rdul phra mo ste rdul phran gnyis tshogs pa nas brtsams te/ yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi phreng ba dag la rtsom thengs re la yon tan lcid lhag re skye yang / de srang la bcal ba nyid kyi phyir na/ rdzas re re ba gzhan gyi lcid nyid ni/ srang gis ji lta ba bzhin mi rtogs pa'i phyir/

dper na/ ras khur chen po'i steng du/ ras bal gyi 'dab ma re re nas bzhag pa'i tshe/ de la lcid yod kyang de srang gis mi rtogs pa bzhin no/ /zhes zer ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ phra mo nas brtsams rdzas phreng dag /bcal nyid phyir na rdzas gzhan kyi/ /lcid nyid mi rtogs ras bal gyi/ /'dab bzhag bzhin zhes gzhan dag zer/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa don la nang 'gal 'byung bas dgag pa ni/ khyod kyis nyes spong gi tshig de la/ khas blangs snga phyi 'gal ba dang / rang tshig dngos shugs 'gal bas kyang / gnod byed srang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i lcid/ srang gis mi rtogs zhes par song 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /srang gis ji lta ba bzhin mi rtogs par khas blangs kyi gtan nas mi rtogs par khas ma blangs so snyam na yang / thog mar rdzas rtsom thengs re la yon tan lcid lhag re skye zhes pa de la rigs pa ston pa ni/ de yi cig char zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang phyed de/ de 'bru la sbyar na/ lcid mnyam kyi 'jim ril bcu tshan gnyis yod pa de'i/ bcu tshan gcig cig car du ldan pa ste sdom pa dang / gcig so sor te rim bzhin ldan pa ste sdom pa'i rdul gyi tshogs pa gnyis po dag srang mthil so sor g.yas g.yon du srang gcig la lhan cig bcal ba na/ de gnyis la lcid lhag ni mang nyung tha dad par 'gyur bar thal/ ril gyis sdom pa de la lcid lhag dgu skyes/ cig car sdom pa de la lcid lhag gcig las ma skyes pa de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gser ma sha ka la sogs pa lcid mnyam bcu tshan gnyis las/ gcig cig car dang / cig shos rim pa yis bsres pa'i tshe na/ de gnyis lcid mnyam bcu tshan re rer grangs mtshungs par ni mi rung bar thal/ de gnyis la lcid lhag che chung dang mang nyung sogs tha dad yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na/ bstan bcos dang 'jig rten gyi grags pas kyang gnod do zhes 'chad pa la/ de yi cig car ldan pa dang / /so sor ldan pa'i rdul tshogs dag

/so sor lhan cig bcal ba na/ /de phyir lcid ni tha dad 'gyur/ /ma sha la sogs rim pa yis/ /grangs mtshungs par ni mi rung ngo / /zhes so/ /'dir phra mo nas brtsam zhes sogs phyogs snga len pa'i tshe/ lcid lhag srang gis mi rtogs par khas blangs zhes pa yang mi 'thad de/ der lcid lhag srang gis mi rtogs par khas blangs na/ so sor lhan cig bcal ba na/ /zhes slar yang / srang la bcal na lcid lhag tha dad 'byung bar thal ba'i rigs pa 'phen pa de mkhas pa'i rnam 'gyur ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /slar yang rigs pa snga ma la ma khyab pa'i nyes spong 'gog byed bcas pa ston pa la/ gal te yungs dkar sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ de 'bru la sbyar na/ gal te bye brag pa na re/ rigs pa snga ma de phyir lcid ni tha dad 'gyur ba ma khyab ste/ yungs dkar nas brtsams te rdul kyi tshogs chen po gong nas gong du ni 'phel ba dang ldan pa'i 'bru'am yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi phreng ba'i lci ba ste lcid lhag srang gis rtogs pa ma yin na ste min par/ zhes 'chad pa la/ gal te yungs dkar nas brtsams te/ /tshogs chen gong nas gong du ni/ /'phel ldan 'bras bu'i phreng ba yi/ /lci ba rtogs pa ma yin na/ /zhes so/ /de dgag pa la/ 'o na/ yan lag can gyi rdzas de'i rtsom byed kyi rgyu rdul phra rab kyi ljid nyid ni srang gi gzhal byar 'gyur bar thal/ srang gi gzhal byar gyur pa'i lcid yod pa gang zhig yan lag can 'bras bu'i lcid ni srang gis mi rtogs pa'i phyir te/ yungs dkar yan chad kyi lcid kyang srang gis mi rtogs/ phra mo nas yungs dkar gyi bar gyi lcid dag kyang chung ngu shin tu rtogs par dka' bas te srang gis mi rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ yan lag can rtsom byed kyi rdul phra rab rnams la lcid sogs chos gsum dang / mthong thogs kyi bya ba sogs gang yang khas mi len zhes pa'i khas blangs dang / khas blangs snga phyi 'gal lo/

/zhes 'chad pa la/ yungs dkar bar gyi lcid dag kyang / /chung ngu shin tu rtogs dka' bas/ /'bras bu'i lcid ni mi rtogs phyir/ /de yi rgyu nyid gzhal byar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dpe la chos mthun med pas dgag pa ni/ khyod kyis ras 'dab bzhin/ zhes pa de/ dpe don mi mtshungs te/ ras 'dab kyi ngo bo mngon sum du mthong yang / khyod kyi lcid lhag gi don de mthong ba med pa'i phyir te/ ras 'dab la lcid kyi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba rtogs pa yod pa bzhin du/ khyod kyi lcid lhag de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba'ang rtogs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ don de mthong med ras 'dab bzhin/ /de yi 'bras bu'ang rtogs pa med/ /ces so/ /bzhi pa 'phros don yon tan lhag po dgag pa ni/ lcid nyid mi rtogs zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de 'bru la sbyar na/ 'o na/ bye brag pa 'dod pa'i yan lag can la/ reg bya'i yon tan lcid lhag med kyang / gzugs sogs kyi yon tan lhag pa gzhan yang yod do snyam na/ gser ma sha ka la sogs pa'i yan lag can chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i yon tan lhag po gzhan gang yang yod pa ma yin te/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i reg bya'i yon tan lcid lhag po nyid mi rtogs pa bzhin du/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i 'dod yon gzhan bzhi po de'i yon tan lhag po gzugs sgra la sogs pa thams cad kyang rtogs pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ lcid nyid mi rtogs bzhin du de'i/ /yon tan thams cad rtogs med phyir/ /ma sha la sogs lhag yod min/ /zhes so/ /'o na/ slob dpon phyogs glang gi reg bya'i yon tan lcid lhag kho na 'gog pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ tshad ma mdor/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i rigs pa de ni chos can/ khyod bye brag pa 'dod pa'i yan lag can la yon tan lhag po gzhan 'gog byed kyi rigs nye bar mtshon pa'i dpe tsam yin te/

dngos su reg bya'i yon tan lcid lhag bkag pas/ shugs la yon tan gzugs sgra sogs kyang 'gog pa'i mtshon byed yin pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa la/ dma' med de ni nyer mtshon te/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa mngon sum tshad mas bsal ba phab pa de 'chad pa la/ gzugs sogs zhes sogs tshig rkang gnyis so/ /de 'bru la sbyar na/ bye brag pa 'dod pa'i yan lag can chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i gzugs sogs kyi yon tan lhag po yod pa las/ mngon sum tshad mas bsal ba 'bab pa yin te/ khyod la de lta bu'i gzugs kyi yon tan lhag po dang / sogs sgras bsdus pa/ sgra dri ro reg bya'i yon tan lhag po yod na mngon sum so sos ji lta ba bzhin mthong dgos pa las/ rang rang gi gi dbang po la brten pa'i gzugs 'dzin mngon sum la sogs pas mthong ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ gzugs sogs lhag dang lhag ci bzhin/ /rang gi dbang pos mthong med phyir/ /zhes so/ /gal te kha cig na re/ gzhung 'di mngon sum kyis gnod byed ston pa la sbyor ba mi 'thad de/ skabs 'dir lcid sogs chos gsum la gnod byed ston pa'i skabs yin pa gang zhig de la 'dir mngon sum gyi gnod byed ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhe na/ de ni gnad ma zin pa ste/ gzugs sogs lhag dang lhag ci bzhin/ /zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ reg 'dzin dbang mngon gyis/ reg bya'i yon tan lcid lhag ma mthong zhes bshad pa ma mthong bar zad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa tshul des phyi ma gnyis kyang mtshon par bstan pa la/ khas blangs zhes sogs shlau ka gcig go /'di 'bras bu dang sbyar na lha rgyan gyi lugs gnyis las rgyan ltar na/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la/ gal te 'di lci 'og 'gror 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gnod byed kyi tshad ma ji skad bshad pa'i phyogs kyis ni/ dam bca' phyi ma gnyis kyi zhen don la rjes dpag sogs kyis gnod pa'i dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya ba yin te/

chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' ltar snang gi zhen don la/ khas blangs dang rang gi tshig dang / sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa/ grags pa mngon sum rjes dpag rnams kyis gnod pa dag ni srid pas na ste/ gnod byed bshad zin pa des/ phyi ma gnyis kyang mtshon nas shes nus pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad pa la/ khas blangs rang gi tshig sogs kyis/ /gnod pa dag ni srid pas na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i phyogs kyis ni/ /dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /zhes so/ /rang lugs kyang rgyan gyi 'di bzhin 'chad/ gnyis pa lha dbang ltar na/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'i zhen don la/ gal te 'di lci zhes pa nas/ rang gi dbang po mthong med phyir/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rjes dpag gi gnod byed bstan zin par ma zad/ chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'i zhen don la ni/ khas blangs dang / rang gi tshig dang sogs kyis bsdus pa mngon sum dang grags pa rnams kyis kyang gnod pa dag kyang srid pas na/ ji skad bshad pa'i chos kyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca'i phyogs la ni khas blangs sogs gnod byed kyi dper brjod dang / dam bca' phyi ma gnyis kyi zhen don la yang gnod pa'i dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya ste/ snga mas mtshon nus pa'i phyir ro zhes 'chad pa la/ lha'i 'gyur las/ khas blangs rang gi tshig sogs kyis/ /gnod pa dag kyang yod pas na/ /ji skad bshad pa'i phyogs la ni/ /dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'chad tshul 'di ni cung zad mi 'thad de/ gzugs sogs lhag dang lhag ci bzhin/ /zhes sogs kyis/ mngon sum gyi gnod tshul ston zhes dpal 'bum phrag gsum pas bshad pa de/ chos grags kyi dgongs pa rma med pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhung 'di'i 'bru la dpal shākya mchog ldan/ mngon sum don dang zhes sogs chos kyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dam bca' la/ sel byed tshad ma bzhis gnod tshul ji skad bshad pa'i phyogs kyis ni chos can/

de las gzhan dam bca' phyi ma gsum gyi dper brjod dang / de'i zhen don la tshad mas gnod tshul yang rtogs par bya ste/ yan lag rnams ni zhes sogs dam bca' de gsum las zhe 'dod la yan lag can rdzas gzhan chos gsum ldan du dam bcas shing / chos gsum po de la dam bca' ba po'i khas blangs snga phyi dang / rang tshig dngos shugs dang / mngon sum dang rjes dpag dang / lha dbang ltar na grags pas kyang gnod pa dag ni srid pas na'o/ /zhes bshad gnang ba yang mi 'thad de/ don de ni/ 'dis grub yan lag gyur pa yi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad des bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa lha rgyan 'grel pa'i kha skong bshad pa ni/ de ltar bshad bya mdo dang / 'chad byed rnam 'grel du mi gsal ba dang / cung zad ma tshang ba rnams lha rgyan sogs 'grel bshad dag gis kha bskangs te bshad pa la don gnyis te/ dam bca' ngos 'dzin la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ sel byed rigs pa la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ spyir dam bca' de la/ chos kyi ngo bo dang khyad par/ chos can gyi khyad par dang ngo bo ste/ de bzhi sgrub pa'am 'gog pa'i dam bca' bzhi yod pa'i dang po ni/ sgra mnyan bya ma yin zhes dang / sbyin pa spyad pa las bde ba mi 'byung zhes dang / ri bong can zla sgras brjod du mi rung zhes dang / sgra rtag pa yin zhes pa'i dam bca' rnams ni/ chos kyi ngo bo sgrub pa'am chos kyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dam bca' yin la/ dam bca' de dag gi zhen don sel tshul ni/ gong du bshad zin nas/ dam bca' phyi ma gsum gyi dper brjod dang / de sel byed kyi tshad ma ni 'dir skabs su bab pa las/ chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' ngos 'dzin la/ lha rgyan sogs 'grel mdzad phal cher mthun pa yin te/ yan lag lci sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de/ chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' yin no zhes 'grel mdzad thams cad mthun pa'i phyir ro/

/dam bca' de yang bye brag pa'i lugs la chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' yin te/ yan lag can chos can dang / rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan tsam de chos kyi ngo bo dang / lcid sogs chos gsum chos kyi khyad par yin pa gang zhig de sgrub pa'i phyir du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas pa'i lugs la chos kyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' zhes bya ste/ chos can dang chos kyi ngo bo dang / chos kyi khyad par ngos 'dzin gong bzhin yin pa gang zhig chos can yan lag can de'i steng du/ khyad chos lcid sogs chos gsum la gnod pa 'bab pa'i dam bca' yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid rgyal dbang blo'i dgongs pa yin te/ de'i 'grel par/ yan lag can ni yan lag rnams las gzhan yin no/ /zhes dam bca' ba byas pa la/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir dang / lha'i dgongs pa yin te/ de'i 'grel par/ dper na yan lag rnams las yan lag can gzhan yin zhes dam bca' ba byas pa la zhes dang / ldan don rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can zhes pa'i 'grel par/ lhas/ yan lag rnams kyi ldan pa yod pa la/ yan lag rnams las don gzhan/ yan lag can gyi ming can de yang / rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can/ bya ba dang ldan pa dang / 'phrod pa 'du ba'i rgyu'o/ /zhes sogs dang / de'i 'grel bshad du shākyas/ 'dir yang chos can yan lag can de yan lag dag las don gzhan nyid yin pa bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing / chos de'i khyad par lci ba la sogs pa ma bshad du zin yang / med na mi 'byung ba'i bdag nyid kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyan mkhan po'i dgongs pa'ang yin te/ de'i 'grel par mdo rang 'grel drangs pa'i tshe/ yan lag can ni yan lag rnams las gzhan ma yin te/ srang dma' ba'i khyad par ma bzung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes/ yan lag can yan lag las gzhan du dam bcas pa chos kyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bcar bshad pa'i mdo rang 'grel tshad mar mdzad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/

/'dir dpal shākya mchog ldan dang / rgyang pa sangs lhun sogs/ yan lag can lci sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' 'di/ chos can gyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' yin te/ lcid sogs chos gsum/ khyad gzhi yan lag can de'i khyad chos yin pa gang zhig khyad gzhi yan lag can de chos can du bzung 'dug pa'i phyir dang / mdo rang 'grel gyi 'gyur 'ga' zhig las kyang de ltar bshad 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ gnad ma zin pa yin te/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i yan lag can chos can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin te zhes dam bcas na/ lcid sogs chos gsum chos can gyi khyad par du go ba khyed bden yang / 'dir yan lag can chos can/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin te zhes dam bca'i tshe/ lcid sogs chos gsum/ bsgrub bya'i chos kyi khyad par du song 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mdo rang 'grel de 'gyur ma dag pa yang ma yin te/ de la lha rgyan gyi bshad srol tha dad pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir ro/ /dpyod ldan dag gi snying gi bdud rtsi 'phel bar gyur cig chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' ngos 'dzin pa la/ rgyal dbang blo rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i 'chad tshul/ lha rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i 'chad tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag rnams/ yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bca'i dam bca' 'di/ bye brag pa ltar na chos can kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' dang / sangs rgyas pa ltar na chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' yin zhes 'jog te/ yan lag de chos can gyi ngo bo/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung chos can gyi khyad par yin pa gang zhig de bye brag pas sgrub par 'dod/ sangs rgyas pas 'gog par byed pa'i phyir te/ rgyal dbang blo'i 'grel par/

yan lag rnams yan lag can gzhan yin no/ /zhes dam bca' ba'o/ /'dir yan lag rnams ni chos can de rnams gzhan nyid kyi chos can bsgrub par bya ba'o/ /de rnams kyi 'ba' zhig mngon sum nyid kyi khyad par du pha rol pos 'dod de/ zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyan gyi lugs la/ rgyan gyi 'grel par/ de ltar ma yin te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin yang / yan lag mngon sum yin na ni gzhan yin pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro zhes pa tsam zhig bshad la/ de'i dgongs pa len pa la kha cig mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag rnams yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de la 'jog ste/ yan lag tsam chos can gyi ngo bo dang / mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung chos can kyi khyad par gang zhig khyad par de la gnod pa ston pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bzhed de/ de yang yan lag mngon sum min na ni/ gzhan yin pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i dgongs par 'dod/ yang kha cig yan lag rnams/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can la rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' lta bu la 'jog ste/ yan lag ni chos can dang / yan lag can las rdzas gzhan pa de chos can gyi ngo bo dang / mngon sum gyis mthong rung chos can kyi khyad par yin pa gang zhig de sgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /yan lag rnams ni yan lag can las gzhan ma yin te/ zhes pa des/ yan lag chos can du bstan 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa yin te/ yan lag rnams yan lag can la rdzas gzhan yin pa'i sgrub byed du/ yan lag can mngon sum gyis mthong rung / yan lag mngon sum gyis mthong du mi rung ba bkod nas/ yan lag de yan lag can las rdzas gzhan yin par bsgrubs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yin te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin na yang / yan lag mngon sum min na ni/ gzhan yin pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro zhes dang / mngon sum ma yin pa nyid du thal ba'i phyir zhes yan lag rnams mngon sum gyi mthong rung khyad chos yin pa la gnod byed bstan 'dug pa'i phyir/

de ltar lugs gsum yod pa'i dang po/ mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung gi yan lag chos can du 'dzin pa mi 'thad de mngon sum ma yin pa nyid du thal ba'i phyir zhes pa dang mi 'grig pa'i phyir/ lugs gnyis pa yan lag can chos can du 'dzin pa ni rgyan gyi dgongs par mi 'thad de/ rgyan mdzad pas/ yan lag rnams ni yan lag las gzhan ma yin te/ zhes pa 'di chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' la gnod byed ston pa'i gzhung tshad mar mdzad snang ba dang mi 'grig pa'i phyir/ lugs gsum pa/ yan lag rnams chos can dang / mngon sum gyis mthong rung de'i khyad par du bzung ba de yang mi 'thad de/ rgyan las/ yan lag can mngon sum yin na yang zhes sogs dang mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ skyon ji ltar yod na/ bye brag pas yan lag can chos can dang / mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung chos can gyi khyad par du bzung ba la/ 'o na yan lag dang yan lag can rdzas gzhan ma yin par thal/ yan lag can mngon sum gyis mthong du rung yang / yan lag mngon sum gyis mthong du mi rung ba'i phyir/ zhes 'phen pa yin gyi/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung chos can khyad par du phyogs snga mas khas blangs nas/ yan lag mngon sum gyis mthong rung ma yin pa'i phyir la khos rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na khyod rang rgyan gyi dgongs pa ji ltar 'chad ce na/ mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung gi khyad par byas pa'i yan lag rnams yan lag can las rdzas gzhan yin par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' 'di/ bye brag pas chos can gyi khyad par bsgrub pa'i dam bca' dang / sangs rgyas pas chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' zhes khas len pa yin te/ yan lag chos can dang mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung chos can gyi khyad par du bzung nas/ de yan lag can las rdzas gzhan yin par bye brag pas sgrub/ sangs rgyas pas 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /'di rgyan gyi dgongs pa ni yin te/

rtags las de ltar ma yin te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin na yang / yan lag mngon sum min na ni/ gzhan yin pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /yan lag dag ni yan lag can las gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yin na ni yan lag can yang mngon sum ma yin par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yan lag mngon sum ma yin par ni/ yan lag can mngon sum yin par 'gyur ba rigs pa ma yin te/ yan lag can dang po bzhin chos can/ zhes dang / yang rgyan las/ gang zhig gang gi rang bzhin las/ /tha dad de ni de bzhin gyi/ /de yi ngo bo dmigs med na/ /tha dad par ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /tha dad dmigs pa med par ni/ /tha dad mngon sum du mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyed rang gi 'di la/ mngon sum pa nyid ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang mi 'grig pa'i skyon yod do zhes smras zin pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ bden te/ de ni rang gi yig cha'i tshig zin bkod pa tsam yin mod kyi/ don la skyon de mi 'jug ste/ khos mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung / chos can yan lag gi khyad chos su khas blangs pa la/ yan lag thams cad kyis mi mthong na/ yan lag can bum pa'i yan lag lto ldir ba dang / zhabs zhum pa sogs mngon sum gyis mthong bas gsal lo zhes pa ni/ mngon sum pa nyid ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i lugs ltar na/ chos gsum ldan gyis yan lag can/ mngon sum mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' 'di/ chos can gyi khyad par sgrub pa'am 'gog pa'i dam bca' yin te/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gis khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can bum pa chos can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin te/ yan lag can yin pa'i phyir zhes bkod pa'i tshe na/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi bum pa chos can tsam dang / bum pa chos can gyi ngo bo dang /

de mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi sgo nas/ yan lag las rdzas gzhan pa de chos can gyi khyad par yin zhing / de nyid bye brag pas bsgrub/ sangs rgyas pas 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /de lha'i dgongs pa yin te/ lha'i 'gyur las/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ yan lag can gyi yan lag las gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum nyid ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro zhes yan lag can chos can dang / mngon sum gyis mthong rung chos can gyi khyad par du mdzad gnang ba'i phyir ro/ /'di la mkhas pa go ram pa na re/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' ngos 'dzin pa'i tshe/ yan lag chos can du bzung na/ rdul phran gsum 'dus pa'i gong bu yan lag gsum pa'i ming can de yin la/ de'i tshe yan lag can ni rang gi brtsams pa'i yan lag can ma yin gyi/ rdul phran gnyis 'dus pa'i yan lag can dang po de nyid yin te/ rgyal dbang blos/ yan lag can pha rol po de las tha dad snang ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'ang 'di yin no/ /yan lag can chos can du bzung ba'i tshe yang / sngar gyi yan lag de khyad par med de/ yan lag gsum pa de yan lag dang yan lag can gyi gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir/ zhes bshad pa rgyas par bshad do/ /'di ni kho bos rnam par dpyod pas brtags na mi 'thad par sems te/ bye brag pa kho/ yan lag gsum pa'i ming can yan lag can gnyis pa de/ yan lag can dang po dang rdzas gzhan du sgrub par mi 'dod pa'i phyir te/ kho'i dam bca' gsum po'i zhe 'dod kyi gtso bo ni/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung dang lcid sogs chos gsum gyi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can zhig bsgrub rgyu yin pa gang zhig yan lag can dang po de ni/ mngon sum gyis mthong du mi rung zhing / lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pas/ /kho la sgrub 'dod med pa'i phyir te/ ma mthong ba la 'gras med pa/ /mthong nas yan lag can sgrub 'dod/

/ces bshad pas so/ /'o na/ kho yan lag dang po de mngon sum gyi mthong rung sogs su khas mi len par gang las shes na/ 'grel pa las te/ rgyan gyi 'grel pa gong du drangs pa las/ yan lag mngon sum ma yin par ni/ yan lag can mngon sum yin par ni/ yan lag can mngon sum yin par 'gyur ba rigs pa ma yin te/ yan lag can dang po bzhin no/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen go ram chen po thugs mi dgyes pa mi snang ba zhu lags/ chos can gyi ngo bo sel ba'i dam bca' ngos 'dzin pa la/ mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i yan lag can yod par dam bca'i dam bca' 'di ni/ chos can gyi ngo bo sgrub pa'am 'gog pa'i dam bca' yin te/ yan lag can ni chos can tsam dang / mtshan nyid gsum pa de chos can gyi ngo bo yin zhing / de nyid bye brag pas sgrub sangs rgyas pas 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /mtshan nyid gsum ni bya ba don gzhan gyi rten byed pa yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi mtshan nyid/ yon tan don gzhan gyi rten byed pa yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba'i rgyu byed pa yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi mtshan nyid ces khas len cing / 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba de la yang / bya ba don gzhan dang 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba/ yon tan gzhan dang 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba/ rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phro 'du'i 'brel pa/ zhes gsum tshang bar khas len pa yin te/ ldan don rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/ lhas rdzas kyi mtshan nyid can/ bya ba dang ldan pa dang / yon tan dang ldan pa dang / 'phrad pa 'du ba'i rgyu'o/ /zhes dang / rgyan las/ yan lag can gzhan nyid tsam sgrub par bya ba ni ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang bya ba dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/ 'phrod pa 'du ba can gyi rgyu ni rdzas yin no/ /zhes bya ba rdzas kyi mtshan nyid ldan pa dang / zhes sogs dang / yang de nyid las/ des na der rdzas kyi mtshan nyid ldan pa nyid du bsgrub par bya ba yin te/

de la yang yon tan lci ba nyid dang bya ba thur du 'gro ba nyid/ de dag 'du ba can gyi rgyu yin pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ yan lag gi rnam pa las tha dad par sgrub bo zhes sogs bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa dam bca' de rnams kyi zhen don la gnod byed kyi rigs pa bshad pa la/ dam bca' dang po chos kyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca'i zhen don la gnod byed ni/ gzhung nyid du gsal bar bshad zin nas/ da ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i phyogs kyis ni/ /dper brjod gzhan yang rtogs par bya/ /zhes chos kyi khyad par sel byed bshad pas/ chos can gyi khyad par dang ngo bo sel byed kyang shugs la rtogs par bya'o zhes kha 'phangs pa'i don 'grel pas kha bskangs te bshad pa la gnyis/ chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca'i zhen don sel tshul dang / chos can gyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dam bca'i zhen don sel tshul lo/ /dang po la/ rgyal dbang blos bshad tshul/ rgyan mkhan pos bshad tshul/ lha dbang blos bshad tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag rnams/ rang gi yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa de/ chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bcar ngos bzung nas/ de 'gog pa'i tshe/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi yan lag chos can/ khyod rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du yod pa'i phyir zhes thal 'gyur kyi log rtog gi dbal bcom nas/ shes 'dod dang ldan pa'i tshe/ don de de las gzhan du med de/ der mngon sum gyis ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rtags 'god pa ni rjes dpag gis gnod pa'o/ /gal te rtsa bar ma khyab ste/ de de las rdzas gzhan du yod kyang / de de las rdzas gzhan du mngon sum la mi snang ba'i phyir zer na/ 'o na mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi yan lag rnams mngon sum la mi snang bar thal/ de rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du mngon sum la mi snang ba'i phyir/ 'di'i rtags la lan btab na dngos 'gal yin pas khas blangs snga phyi 'gal bas gnod cing /

'dod lan btab na/ mngon sum gyi bsal pa yang 'bab la/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung / mngon sum gyis mi mthong zhes khas blangs pas/ rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba dang / 'jig rten dang bstan bcos kyi grags pas kyang gnod pa yin no/ /de ltar yang rgyal dbang blo'i 'grel pa sngar drangs pa'i/ 'ga' zhig mngon sum nyid kyi khyad par du pha rol pos 'dod zer/ zhes pa'i 'phro nyid las/ de'ang gzhan nyid du yod na/ de las tha dad par mi snang ba'i phyir/ tha dad pa ma yin no/ /gzhan nyid du yod pa na/ gang zhig gang las tha dad par snang ba ma yin pa de mngon sum ma yin te/ chos can ma yin pa'i yan lag can dang po'i yan lag rnam bzhir/ yan lag rnams kyang gzhan nyid du yod pa na/ yan lag can pha rol po de las tha dad par snang ba ma yin no/ /khyab byed ma dmigs pa'o/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /'grel pa 'di'i snying po bsdus na/ gang zhig rang gang las rdzas tha dad pa'i gzhi de dang rdzas tha dad par mngon sum la mi snang na/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung min pas khyab/ dper na yan lag can dang po'i yan lag dang yan lag can gnyis mngon sum gyis mthong rung min pa bzhin/ yan lag can gnyis pa phan chad kyi yan lag rnams kyang / yan lag pha rol de rang rtsom byed kyi yan lag can de dang rdzas gzhan du mngon sum la mi snang bar khyod kyis khas blangs so/ /zhes pa 'di yin pas/ yan lag can pha rol ces pa/ yan lag dang po la ngos 'dzin pa mi 'thad cing / 'di dang rgyan gnyis gnod byed rigs pa ston tshul gnad gcig tu 'dug pas/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung min pa'i yan lag rnams/ chos can du 'dzin pa 'di'i yang dgongs pa yin nam snyam du kho bo sems so/ /gnyis pa rgyan gyi lugs la/ mngon sum kyis mthong mi rung gi yan lag rnams/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin no zhes dam bcas pa la/ gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung gi yan lag chos can/

khyod rang gis brtsams pa'i yan lag can dang rdzas tha dad par mngon sum la snang bar thal/ khyod de dang rdzas tha dad yin pa'i phyir zhes/ thal 'gyur gyi dbal bcom nas/ shes 'dod dang ldan pa la/ ldog don gyi rtags sngar bzhin 'god pa ni/ rjes dpag gi gnod tshul yin la/ de la kho na re/ ma khyab ste/ yan lag can mngon sum gyis mthong du rung yan lag mngon sum gyis mthong du mi rung ba'i phyir zer na/ 'o na mthong mi rung ba'i yan lag des brtsams pa'i yan lag can de yang mngon sum kyis mthong rung ba ma yin par thal/ rtsom byed yan lag de mngon sum gyis mthong rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na yan lag can dang po rtsom byed kyis yan lag mngon sum gyi mthong rung ma yin pas/ des brtsams pa'i yan lag can dang po yang mngon sum gyi mthong rung ma yin no/ /zhes khyod rang khas len pa bzhin no/ /'dod na/ khas blangs 'gal ba sogs kyis gnod do/ /zhes 'chad pa yin te/ rgyan las/ de lta ma yin te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin yang / zhes pa nas/ yan lag can dang po bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / gang zhig gang gi rang bzhin las/ /zhes sogs sngar drangs pa'i lung gis grub pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa lha'i lugs ni/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa de/ chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' ngos bzung nas/ de 'gog pa'i tshe/ mngon sum kyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa yan lag can chos can/ khyod rang gi yan lag la rdzas gzhan du mngon sum la snang bar thal/ khyod de dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ zhes thal 'gyur 'phangs nas/ shes 'dod dang ldan pa'i tshe rang rgyud 'god tshul sngar ltar byas pas rjes dpag gis brjod la/ gal te kho na re/ rtsa bar ma khyab ste/ yan lag can de mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du yod kyang der mngon la mi snang ba'i phyir zer na/

'o na yan lag can yang mngon sum la mi snang bar thal/ de'i phyir/ 'di'i rtags dngos 'gal yin pas khas blangs dang rang tshig gis gnod/ 'dod na mngon sum dang grags pas gnod pa 'bab pa yin no/ /zhes 'chad de/ yan lag can ni yan lag las gzhan ma yin te/ mngon sum ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa chos can gyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dam bca'i zhen don la gnod pa ston tshul ni/ rgyal dbang blos ltar na/ khos/ yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi mtshan nyid sngar ltar khas blangs pa la/ 'o na rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phrod pa 'du ba de/ yan lag can gyi rdzas kyi mtshan nyid du khas len pa de mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar khas len pa la/ yon tan rdzas su thal ba dang / rdzas ma yin par thal ba'i skyon gnyis gnas pa'i phyir/ ji ltar snyam na/ 'o na yon tan de/ rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phrod pa 'du 'am mi 'du/ dang po ltar na/ yon tan chos can/ khyod rdzas yin par thal/ khyod rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phrod pa 'du ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ gal te mi 'du na/ rdzas de yang / rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phrod pa 'du ba min par thal/ yon tan de de ma yin pa gang zhig rdzas nyid kyi spyi de la/ rdzas de dang 'phrod pa 'du la/ yon tan dang 'phrod pa mi 'du ba'i cha gnyis med pa'i phyir te/ kho cha med pa'i phyir/ gong du 'dod na/ rdzas chos can/ khyod rdzas ma yin par thal/ khyod rdzas nyid kyi spyi dang 'phrod pa mi 'du ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum zhes 'chad de/ mdo rang 'grel las/ rdzas ni yod pa ma yin te/ yon tan rdzas dag rdzas dang rdzas ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes khas blangs kyi gnod byed dngos su bstan pa'i phyir ro// ༈ rgyan dang ya ma shrī ltar na/ yod pa nyid kyi spyi la brten nas gnas pa/ rdzas kyi mtshan nyid kyi zur yin na/ yon tan de yod pa nyid kyi spyi la brten nas gnas sam mi gnas/ dang po ltar na/

yon tan chos can/ rdzas yin par thal/ yod pa nyid kyi spyi la brten nas gnas pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rdzas de yang yod pa nyid kyi spyi la brten nas mi gnas par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig yod pa nyid kyi spyi la/ rdzas kyi rten byed pa dang / yon tan gyi rten mi byed pa'i cha gnyis med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rdzas chos can/ rdzas ma yin par thal/ de la brten nas mi gnas pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ de ltar yang 'thad de/ de gnyis kyi 'grel par de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang bod mkhas pa snga rabs pa ltar na/ rang gi yon tan gyi rten byed pa de rdzas kyi mtshan nyid yin na/ yon tan rna ba de/ rang gi yon tan dkar po'i rten byed dam mi byed/ dang po ltar na/ yon tan rna ba chos can/ rdzas yin par thal/ rang gi yon tan gyi rten byed pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ gnyis pa ltar na/ rdzas ba lang des kyang / rang gi yon tan gyi rten mi byed par thal/ khas len de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rdzas ba lang chos can/ rdzas ma yin par thal/ rang gi yon tan gyi rten mi byed pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ zhes 'khor gsum gyi phreng ba tshar du dngar ba sgrig par mdzad do/ /gal te rgyus med dag na re/ des kho la mi gnod de/ kho'i rdzas kyi zur gsum po gang la yang mi gnod pa'i phyir ro zer na/ ma grub ste/ mtshan nyid kyi zur gsum pa 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba de la/ sngar gyi gnod tshul gsum po des/ khas blangs nang 'gal gyi 'khor gsum kyi char phab pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na spyir bye brag pas/ lcid sogs chos gsum dam bca' gsum gyi zhe 'dod kyi dam bca'i zhen don gyi gtso bo yin kyang / chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa'i tshe/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang / chos can gyi khyad par 'gog pa'i tshe/ yan lag dang yan lag can rdzas gzhan dang / chos can gyi ngo bo 'gog pa'i tshe/ yan lag can rdzas kyi mtshan nyid la gnod byed ston pa yin no zhes dpyod ldan rnams kyi snying gi ze'u 'brur sim par gyur cig

de dag gis ni/ gzhung 'grel gyi snying po dril ba/ klu sgrub kho bos/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pas/ ma sbas par bris pa blo gsal rnams la phan par gyur cig/ ༈ gnyis pa don sbyor ni/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam gnyis chos can/ khyod kyis/ rgol bye brag pa'i grub pa'i rtsa ba/ dam bca' gsum gyi zhen don sun phyung nas/ rgol ba bye brag pa de rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul yod de/ dam bca' gsum gyi zhen don la mngon sum gyi bsal ba phab/ thal 'gyur gyis log rtog bcom nas/ rang rgyud kyi rjes dpag tshad ma skyed par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ gnod bya'i dam bca' dngos bzung ba/ de la gnod byed kyi rigs pa bstan pa/ rigs pa de la dogs pa'i gnad bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ bye brag pa'i grub mtha' tshig gi don drug ngos bzung / yan lag can gyi rdzas rtsom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsom pa'i tshul/ brtsams pa'i dam bca' dngos bshad pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ rdzas dang yon tan las dang spyi/ /bye brag 'du ba rnam pa drug /ces pa ltar drug yod pa'i dang po rdzas ni/ yon tan don gzhan gyi rten byed pa ste/ dbye na/ 'byung bzhi nam mkha' phyogs dang dus/ /bdag dang yid de rdzas dgu'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de dgu yang rtag mi rtag gnyis su 'dus te/ nam mkha' sogs phyi ma lnga dang / 'byung bzhi'i rdul phra rab ni rtag pa'i rdzas dang / rags pa yan lag can yan chad ni mi rtag pa'i rdzas so/ /yon tan ni/ rdzas don gzhan la brten pa ste/ dbye na nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /de yang bdag nyid kyi yon tan bcu gsum ni/ dbang po'i blo lnga/ bde sdug dang / chags sdang / chos dang / chos min dang / 'dus byas/ 'bad pa'i shugs rnams so/ /dus phyogs kyi yon tan bdun ni/ grangs dang / bong tshod/ so so dang / phrad pa/ dbye ba/ gzhan dang ni/ gzhan min zhes pa rnam pa bdun/ 'byung bzhi nam mkha'i yon tan lnga ste/ dri ro gzugs reg bya sgra rnams so/

/las ni lnga ste/ brkyang bskum 'degs 'jog 'gro rnams so/ /spyi ni ngo bo cha med rtag rdzas bsal ba rnams la khyab pa ste/ dbye na yod pa nyid lta bu khyab pa'i spyi dang / ba lang nyid lta bu nyi che ba'i spyi gnyis so/ /de la yang bsal ba yod par 'gro ba des thar ra'i lugs dang / bsal ba yod med kun tu 'gro ba dpe lug ka'i lugs gnyis yod do/ /bye brag ni rang gang la gnas pa'i rten de/ chos gzhan las khyad par du byed pa'i byed chos shig ste/ dkar po dang nag po sogs so/ /'du ba ni/ spyi dang gsal ba rdzas dang yon tan dang rten pa sogs sbrel byed kyi 'brel ba po las don gzhan pa zhig ste/ dbye na 'phrod 'du 'brel ba sogs 'khrul med kyi 'brel ba lnga yod do zhes bzhed do/ /de ltar khas len pa'i bye brag pa 'di la/ 'ug phrug pa zhes kyang bya la/ dbyug pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /'di dang rigs pa can pa gnyis grub mtha' phal cher 'dra zhing / nang gses cung mi 'dra ba ni/ drang srong rkang mig gis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos lta ba'i rigs pa'i rjes su 'brang ba la rigs pa can pa dang / drang srong gzegs zan gyis brtsams pa'i bstan bcos bye brag bsal ba'i rjes su 'brang ba la bye brag pa zhes gnyis su dbye ba'i gnad kyis yin no/ /gnyis pa yan lag can gyi rdzas rtsom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad yan lag can gyi rdzas la rag las pa'i phyir ro/ /de ma brtsams na/ mthong thogs sgrib gsum kyi bya ba byed mi nus/ de ma nus na/ snod bcud kyi 'jig rten chags 'jig mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa yan lag can gyi rdzas rtsom pa'i tshul la/ mkhas grub bstan gsal dang / kun mkhyen go ram sogs phal che ba rnams/ kho'i lugs la/ rigs mthun gyi rdul phran gnyis phrad pa na/ yan lag gnyis pa dang / yan lag can dang po zhes bya zhing / des mthong thogs sogs kyi bya ba byed mi nus/

rigs mthun gyi rdul phran gsum phrad pa na/ yan lag can gsum pa dang yan lag can gnyis pa zhes bya zhing / de yan chad nas mthong thogs sogs kyi bya ba byed nus so zhes/ rdul phran gnyis dang gsum la/ yan lag gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i tha snyad mdzad snang yang / rang re'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas 'di ltar bshad de/ kho'i lugs la/ 'jig rten zhig nas stong par gnas pa'i tshe/ rdul phra rab rnams/ ma zhig pa sil bu rtag par gnas la/ de nas sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis rdul phra rab rnams phrad nas/ yan lag can gyi rdzas rtsom pa yin la/ de yang rigs mi mthun ji tsam 'phrad kyang rtsom mi nus te/ rigs mi mthun rnams rtsom med phyir/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ des na rdul rigs mi mthun nam/ rigs mthun pa rdul phra rab lta bu drug man chad phrad kyang ldan pa tsam las/ yan lag can rtsom mi nus te/ de rtsom pa la dbus rdul phra rab gcig la phyogs drug gi rdul phra rab drug gis bskor dgos pas/ rdul phra rab bdun 'phrad dgos pa'i phyir dang / rigs mthun gyi rdul phra rab bdun phrad pa'i tshe/ yan lag gnyis pa dang / yan lag can dang po'i ming can mthong thogs kyi bya ba byed mi nus pa/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang mi ldan pa/ gnas skabs rtag pa yin pa'i rdul phran zhig skye ste/ de rdul phra rab las 'das pa'i rdul phran tsam yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rdul phran gnyis phrad pa'i tshe na/ yan lag gsum pa/ yan lag can gnyis pa'i ming can yan lag can rags pa mtshan nyid pa zhig skye ste/ de lta bu de ni/ mthong thogs sgrib gsum dang ldan pa/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa/ rang bzhin rtag pa/ gnas skabs mi rtag pa yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir/ de yan chad rdul phran re dang phrad thengs re la/ khyad chos de dag dang ldan pa'i yan lag can re skye ba yin te/ phra mo nas brtsam rjes phreng dag /ces bshad pas so/

/'o na yan lag dang yan lag can gyi rgyun khas len nam snyam na/ khas mi len te/ yan lag can dang po ni yan lag mtshan nyid pa yin yang / yan lag can btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de la de'i mtshan nyid lcid sogs chos gsum dang / mthong thogs sgrib gsum gyi khyad chos ma tshang ba'i phyir te/ yan lag can dang po bzhin/ zhes rtags 'grel sngar drangs zin pa las shes pa'i phyir dang / yan lag can mtshan nyid pa yin yang / yan lag btags pa ba yin pa'i phyir te/ yan lag mtshan nyid pa la/ rdul phra rab dang / rdul phran gang rung yin dgos pa las/ yan lag gsum pa yan chad ni rags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rgyal dbang blo'i 'grel par/ de rnams kyi'ang 'ga' zhig ni mngon sum nyid du pha rol pos 'dod do zhes bshad pa ma yin nam snyam na de ni yan lag btags pa ba 'ga' zhig mngon sum gyis mthong rung du 'dod pa'i don yin no/ /zhes 'chad pa las gzhan thabs med do/ /'o na khyod kyi yan lag can dang po de la/ yan lag gnyis pa zhes 'chad pa mi 'thad de/ de'i yan lag rdul phran gnyis kyang med/ de'i yan lag rags pa gnyis kyang med/ rdul phra rab ni bdun yang 'dug pa'i phyir zhe na/ de'i lan ni/ re zhig gter du sba bar bya'o/ /des na rags pa rtsom pa'i phyi nang gi grub mtha' la mi mthun pa gsum byung ste/ bye brag pa ni rdul phra rab bdun po de 'byor ba'i tshul kyis rtsom/ rang sde bye smra ba reg la ma 'byar ba bskor ba bar dang bcas pas rtsom/ mdo sde pa ma reg ma 'byar yang bskor ba bar med pas rtsom par bzhed de/ 'byar ba'am ni reg pa'am/ /bar med rnam par gnas kyang rung / /zhes 'dod pa so sor bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa brtsam pa'i 'bras bu yan lag can gyi rdzas dam bca' tshul la gsum/ zhe 'dod kyi kun slong / smras tsam gyi dam bca'/ zhe 'dod kyi dam bca'o/ /dang po ni/ bye brag pas/ chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa dang /

chos can gyi khyad par sgrub pa dang / chos can gyi ngo bo sgrub pa'i dam bca' mi 'dra ba gsum dam bcas kyang / zhe 'dod la lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i yan lag can zhig sgrub par 'dod pa yin te/ lcid sogs chos gsum po dam bca' dang po'i tshe/ sgrub chos kyi khyad par du bzung nas sgrub/ dam bca' gnyis pa'i tshe/ shes 'dod chos can gyi ngo bor bzung nas sgrub pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la'ang gsum las/ yan lag can ni yan lag rnams las rdzas gzhan yin no/ /zhes pa'i dam bca' ni/ chos kyi khyad par gyi smra tsam gyi dam bca'/ yan lag rnams ni yan lag can las rdzas gzhan yin no zhes pa'i dam bca' ni/ chos can gyi khyad par gyi smras tsam gyi dam bca'/ rdzas ni yod do zhes pa'i dam bca' ni chos can gyi ngo bo'i smras tsam gyi dam bca' 'o/ /gsum pa zhe 'dod kyi dam bca' la'ang gnyis/ gtso bo'i dam bca' dang / khyad par gyi dam bca' gnyis/ dang po ni/ yan lag can/ mthong thogs kyi bya ba byed pa/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' 'di/ bye brag pa'i zhe 'dod kyi dam bca'i gtso bo yin te/ dam bca' gsum char gyi zhe 'dod 'di nyid sgrub par 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa khyad par gyi dam bca' la'ang gsum/ chos kyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca'/ chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca'/ chos can gyi ngo bo la gnod pa'i dam bca' dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ rang ldog la brten pa ni/ yan lag can lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' lta bu yin la/ gzhi ldog la brten pa ni/ bum pa de/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bum pa'i yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' lta bu ste/ rgyu mtshan gong du bshad zin to/ /des na bum pa chos can/ lcid sogs chos gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin te/

yan lag can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes snga rgol bye brag pas/ phyi rgol sangs rgyas pa'i ngor bkod pa'i tshe na/ bum pa chos can du bzung nas/ lcid sogs chos gsum ni bsgrub bya'i chos/ yan lag can rdzas gzhan de'i khyad chos su bkod par song bas/ gtan tshigs de ni chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i gtan tshigs dang / dam bca' de ni chos kyi khyad par sgrub pa'i dam bca' yin no/ /zhes gnad kyi snying por gces so/ /gnad 'di ma rtogs par/ dam bca' de chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin zhes/ mkhas pa shaka sangs gnyis gsungs pa ni/ rnam dpyod kyi zur ha cang rno thal ba'o/ /dam bca' gnyis pa ngos 'dzin la/ rgyal dbang blo ltar na/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag rnams rang gi yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' lta bu la/ rang gi yig char ngos 'dzin mdzad la/ de yang rang ldog yin gyi/ don ldog gi dbang du byas na/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi bum pa'i yan lag rnams bum pa'i yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' ni/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' 'o zhes 'chad dgos par snang ngo / /rang lugs yig char/ rgyan gyi dgongs pa len pa'i lugs gsum ngos bzung nas skyon btang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rang lugs ngos 'dzin mi snang yang / mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag rnams rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' ni/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin no zhes rgyan gyi dgongs par kho bo 'chad de/ de yang gzhi ldog la sbyar na/ mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i rdul phran gnyis po de/ rang gis brtsams pa'i yan lag can gnyis pa dang rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin no zhes 'chad dgos pa'i phyir te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin na yang /

zhes sogs rgyan gyi lung de las gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /lha dbang blo ltar na/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' lta bu de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin te/ yan lag can chos can dang / mngon sum gyis mthong rung de'i khyad par du byas nas de la gnod pa ston pa'i phyir/ zhes rang lugs kyi yig char gsal bas so/ /de gzhi ldog la sbyar ba yang shes sla'o/ /dam bca' gsum pa ngos 'dzin la/ mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa'i yan lag can gyi rdzas yod par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de/ chos can gyi ngo bo sel ba'i dam bca' ste/ de yang gzhi gcig la sbyar na/ yon tan gzhan gyi rten byed pa/ bya ba don gzhan gyi rten byed pa/ 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba'i rgyu byed pa ste/ mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyi yan lag gnyis pa dang gsum pa la sogs pa'i rdzas yod par dam bcas pa'i dam bca' de/ chos can gyi ngo bo sel ba'i dam bca' zhes bya ste/ yan lag can gnyis pa sogs chos can dang / mtshan nyid gsum po de'i ngo bo gang zhig de la gnod pa ston pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gnod byed kyi rigs pa ngos bzung ba la'ang gsum las/ dang po chos kyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' zhen don sun dbyung ba la/ rjes dpag gis gnod tshul/ khas blangs rang tshig grags pas gnod tshul/ mngon sum gyis gnod tshul gsum las/ dang po la'ang thal rang gnyis las/ dang po thal 'gyur 'phen tshul ni/ lcid mnyam gyi 'jim ril srang re ba bcu tshan gnyis las bcu tshan gcig bsdoms pa'i gong bu chos can/ rgyu rang rgyu lhan cig ma bsdoms pa'i 'jim ril srang re ba bcu tshan la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba de yod par thal/ khyod de gnyis yan lag gi lcid mnyam pa gang zhig khyod la lhan cig ma bsdoms pa'i 'jim ril srang re ba bcu tshan la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'am/

de yang gzhi gcig la sbyar na/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba yod par thal/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid sogs lhag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni/ 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i rtags 'phen par byed pa'i rgyu dmigs kyi thal 'gyur yang dag go /gnyis pa rang rgyud la rgyu mi dmigs pa/ rang bzhin mi dmigs pa/ 'bras bu mi dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag gsum rang lugs kyi yig char bshad de/ dang po ni/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba med de/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa'i tshe na/ de de sgrub kyi rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med de/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa'i tshe na/ de de sgrub kyi rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa chos can/ khyod la rang gi yan lag la med pa'i chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med de/ khyod la de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba med pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod pa'i tshe na/ de de sgrub kyi 'bras bu ma dmigs pa'i rtags yin no/ /gnyis pa khas blangs kyi gnod tshul sogs gong du bshad zin/ gnyis pa chos can gyi khyad par la gnod pa'i dam bca' sel byed la'ang / rjes dpag gi gnod tshul sogs gsum gsum yod pa'i/ rtags 'god pa'i snying po bsdus na/ rang lugs yig cha'i tshig zin la/ rgyal dbang blo dang rgyan ltar na/ yan lag rnams chos can/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du med de/

der ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang lha'i dgongs pa rang lugs su mdzad nas/ yan lag can chos can/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du med de/ der ma dmigs pa'i phyir zhes bkod snang yang / sbyor ba 'god tshul de ltar na/ chos kyi khyad par sel bar song gi chos can gyi khyad par sel bar yang ma song yang / lhag par rgyan dang rgyal dbang gi dgongs pa yang mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi yan lag chos can du mi 'dzin par sems so/ /des na/ rgyal dbang blo ltar na/ mngon sum kyis mthong mi rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can gnyis pa'i yan lag rdul phran rnams chos can/ yan lag can pha rol te/ rang gis brtsams pa'i yan lag can de las rdzas gzhan yin te/ rang gi yan lag can de'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir zhes/ bye brag pas sangs rgyas pa la 'god pa yin la/ de'i tshe/ mngon sum gyis mthong mi rung gi yan lag gnyis pa'i yan lag rdul phran rnams rang gis brtsams pa'i yan lag can gnyis pa las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa lta bu ni/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin la/ de la gnod byed ston pa na/ yan lag can gnyis pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran rnams chos can/ khyod yan lag can pha rol te/ rang gi yan lag can gnyis pa las rdzas tha dad par mngon sum la snang ba ma yin te/ khyod mngon sum gyis mthong rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ yan lag can dang po'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phra rab rnams bzhin no/ /zhes/ spyir mngon sum la snang rung bkag pas/ khyab bya/ yan lag can dang rdzas tha dad par mngon sum la snang ba 'gog pa'i khyab bya de ma dmigs pa'i rtags 'god pa yin te/ rgyal dbang blo'i 'grel pa sngar drangs pa ltar/ de'ang gzhan nyid du yod na de las tha dad par mi snang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa nas/ yan lag can dang po'i yan lag rnams bzhin no/ /yan lag rnams kyang gzhan nyid du yod pa na/

yan lag can pha rol po de las tha dad pa snang ba ma yin no/ /khyab byed ma dmigs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gzhung tshig la blo gros gsal ba'i mig gis bltas na shes pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyan ltar na yang / dam bca'i ngos 'dzin rgyal dbang ltar las/ gnod byed ston pa'i tshe/ yan lag gnyis pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran rnams chos can/ khyod yan lag can gnyis pa de las rdzas gzhan du yod pa ma yin te/ khyod der mngon sum gyis ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i rang bzhin ma dmigs pa'i rtags 'god de/ de ni/ gang zhig gang gi rang bzhin las/ /de yi ngo bo dmigs med na/ /tha dad par ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang / de lta ma yin te/ yan lag can mngon sum yin yang / yan lag mngon sum min na ni/ /gzhan yin pa nyid mi 'gyur ro/ /gal te kho na re/ ma khyab ste/ yan lag can gnyis pa de mngon sum la snang yang / de'i yan lag rdul phran rnams mngon sum la mi snang ba'i phyir zer na/ 'o na yan lag can gnyis pa de yang mngon sum la mi snang bar thal/ de'i yan lag rnams mngon sum la mi snang ba gang zhig yan lag dang yan lag can rnams mngon sum la snang mi snang mtshungs dgos pa'i phyir/ dper na/ khyed rang gis yan lag can dang po'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phra rab rnams mngon sum la mi snang bas/ yan lag can dang po de yang mngon sum la mi snang ngo zhes khas blangs pa bzhin no/ /don de ni/ yan lag mngon sum min par ni/ yan lag can mngon sum yin par rigs pa ma yin te/ yan lag can dang po bzhin/ zhes pa'i gzhung 'di dgongs pa'o/ /des na bye brag pa yan lag la mngon sum la snang mi snang cha gnyis khas len par snang ste/ rdul phran du ma phrad pa'i yan lag can rnams kyi yan lag rnams mngon sum la mi snang / rags pa du ma phrad pa'i yan lag can rnams kyi yan lag rnams mngon sum la snang ba'i phyir/ zhes pa de ni/ rgyal dbang blo'i 'grel par/

de rnams nyid las 'ga' zhig gi mngon sum nyid du pha rol po 'dod de/ zhes pa'i gzhung gi dgongs pa'o/ /rgyal dbang blo dang / rgyan mkhan po'i dgongs pa'i gter mdzod 'di kho bos phye ste/ skal bzang rnams la dga' ston du byin pa yin no/ /lha'i lugs ltar na/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can chos can/ khyod rang rtsom byed kyi yan lag rdul phran de las rdzas gzhan du med de/ khyod der mngon sum kyis ma dmigs pa'i phyir zhes pa'i rtags 'god la/ gal te ma grub bo snyam na/ yan lag can gnyis pa'i yan lag rdul phran rnams kyang mngon sum la snang bar thal lo/ /'dod na/ khas blangs dngos 'gal yin no/ /des na lha lugs la/ mngon sum kyis mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bcar khas len pa'i gnad kyang / mngon sum kyis mthong rung gi yan lag can gnyis pa de/ khyod rang gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran mngon sum kyis mthong mi rung de las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin zhes pa'i don yin la/ gnad 'di shes na lha rgyan gnyis po de/ yan lag can chos can du 'dzin pa dang / yan lag chos can du 'dzin pa'i khyad par 'dra ba tsam ma gtogs/ don la yan lag can gnyis pa mngon sum la snang rung de dang / de'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran mngon sum la snang mi rung gnyis rdzas gzhan du khas blangs pa la gnod byed ston par gnad gcig tu song bas/ lha rgyan dgongs pa 'gal med kyi gnad dang / yan lag dang yan lag can chos can du 'dzin tshul 'gal med kyi gnad 'di kho bo 'ga' zhig gi spyod yul yin no/ /lha rgyan gnyis kyi rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa de/ bdag sogs kun gyi rgyud la thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig go /gsum pa chos can gyi ngo bo sel byed kyi rigs pa yang /

bshad pa'i skabs su dran zin pas des 'thus so/ /gsum pa rigs pa de la dogs pa'i gnad bstan pa la'ang gnyis/ chos kyi khyad par sel ba'i skabs su dogs pa dpyad pa dang / chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i skabs su dogs pa dpyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang lugs kyi yi ger/ chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa la/ rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags sogs gsum bkod pa'i dang po ni/ yan lag can chos can/ lcid sogs chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba med de/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'bras bu ma dmigs pa ni/ yan lag can chos can/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med de/ de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rang bzhin ma dmigs pa ni/ yan lag can chos can/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med de/ de tshad mas dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes bkod nas/ de dag rgol ba po'i ngor rtags su 'gyur snyam na/ de 'dra'i tshul gsum tshad mas shes/ bsgrub bya la shes 'dod the tshom dang ldan pa'i bye brag pa'i ngor rtags su 'gyur zhes pa la dang pos dpyad na/ 'o na byas rtags kyi sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshad mas nges/ sgra rtag mi rtag the tshom za ba'i grangs can gyi ngor byas pa sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa'i rtags yin par thal/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag tshad mas ma dmigs pa'i rtags kyi yan lag can la/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med par sgrub pa'i tshul gsum tshad mas nges/ yan lag can la/ de 'dra'i lcid lhag yod med the tshom za ba'i bye brag pa'i ngor/ de de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i grangs can de/ grangs can yin par thal lo/ /gal te de 'dra'i grangs can med zer na/ de 'dra'i bye brag pa yang med par thal lo/ /des na de 'dra'i rigs rgyun du gyur pa'i rgol ba zhig gi ngor rtags yang dag tu 'gyur ro zhes khas blang bar bya'o/

/yang yan lag can la chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med par nges nas/ yan lag can la chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba yod med them tshom za ba'i gang zag yod par thal/ de de skor gyi rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de 'dra'i gang zag chos can/ khyod yan lag can la chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu yod med the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod de la de'i 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba yod med the tshom za ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de min par thal/ khyod de la de 'dra'i lcid lhag med par nges pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ yang chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag de chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba'i rgyu yin pa zhig srid par thal/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag med pa de/ yan lag can la de 'dra'i bya ba med par sgrub pa'i rgyu ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos gsum ldan gyi lcid lhag yod par thal lo/ /'dod na/ lcid lhag dang / lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba gnyis 'phrod pa 'du ba'i rgyu yod par thal lo/ /'dod na/ 'phro 'du 'brel ba yod par thal lo zer na/ de gnyis rgyu 'bras rang lugs la khas mi len kyang / rgol ba bye brag pas de gnyis rgyu 'bras su khas blangs pa'i gnad kyis yin zhes khas blangs so/ /yang gson cig gal te 'di lci 'og 'gror 'gyur/ /srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i gzhung 'dis/ rgol ba bye brag pa la/ 'di lci zhes pa khas blangs rtags su bkod nas/ 'og 'gror 'gyur/ zhes pa la mi 'dod pa thal bar 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dag ston byed kyi gzhung yin par thal/ de yin pa dang 'di lci zhes pa khas blangs rtags su bkod nas/ srang ni dma' ba dag tu 'gyur zhes pa mi 'dod thal bar 'phen pa'i thal 'gyur dag ston byed kyi gzhung gang rung yin/

phyi ma min pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas pas bye brag pa la/ yan lag can chos can/ khyod la lcid lhag gi 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba yod par thal/ khyod la lcid lhag yod pa'i phyir zhes mi 'dod pa thal bar 'phangs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bye brag pa des/ yan lag can la lcid lhag gi 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba de yod par khas ma blangs par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ bye brag pa des/ yan lag can lcid sogs chos gsum ldan du khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te phyi ma ma grub na/ bye brag pa de/ yan lag can chos can/ khyod la lcid lhag gi 'bras bu srang mgo thur du 'gro ba'i bya ba yod par thal/ khyod la lcid lhag yod pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur dag 'phang yul gyi rgol ba yin par thal/ gzhung de bye brag pa la de ltar 'phangs pa'i thal 'gyur dag ston byed kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bye brag pa'i ngo bor de sgrub kyi rtags yang dag tu thal lo/ /zhes pa ni mtshon pa ste/ shes ldan dag gis spros te shes par bya'o/ /yang yan lag can la lcid sogs chos gsum ma tshang bar thal/ yan lag can gyi steng du lcid sogs chos gsum tshang ba de chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa'i rtags kyi dgag bya yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshang bar thal/ yan lag can bum pa la lcid sogs chos gsum tshang ba'i phyir/ yan lag can bum pa la lcid lhag kyang tshang / de'i 'bras bu 'og tu 'gro ba'i bya ba yang tshang ba'i phyir zer na/ bum pa de la 'phro 'du'i 'brel ba ma gtogs dang po gnyis tshang ba tsam zhig khas len dgos sam snyam pas ma khyab ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i skabs su dogs pa dpyad pa la/ yan lag can mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas/ yan lag las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin par lha'i dgongs par 'chad pa dag gson cig

'o na yan lag can mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas/ yan lag las rdzas gzhan ma yin par thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de yin par thal/ yan lag can mngon sum gyi mthong rung gang zhig yan lag can de yan lag dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis ka grub ste/ yan lag dang yan lag can rdzas gzhan tsam zhig nang pa sangs rgyas pa yang khas len pa'i phyir te/ khyad par can min gzhan yod ni/ /sgrub na grub pa sgrub pa nyid/ /ces bshad pa'i phyir/ /yang rtsa ba'i gsal ba der thal/ yan lag can bum pa de/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi sgo nas/ bum pa'i yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir te/ bum pa mngon sum gyi mthong rung gang zhig de bum pa'i yan lag dang rdzas gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ yang yan lag rnams mngon sum gyi mthong mi rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i sgo nas/ yan lag can las rdzas gzhan du dam bcas pa de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin pa/ rgyan gyi dgongs par 'chad pa dag gson cig 'o na yan lag rnams mngon sum gyi mthong du mi rung bas khyad par du byas par thal/ dam bca' de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ yan lag yin na mngon sum kyis mthong du mi rung bas khyab par thal lo/ /'dod na/ bum pa'i yan lag bum pa'i mchu dang / lto ldir ba la sogs pas ma nges/ gal te de bum pa'i cha shas tsam yin gyi/ 'dir rtsom byed kyi yan lag cig dgos so snyam na yang / bum pa rtsom byed kyi 'jim pa sogs kyis ma nges so/ /yang mkhas pa go ram pa rdul phran gsum 'dus kyi gong bu yan lag gsum pa'i ming can de/ rdul phran gnyis 'dus kyi gong bu yan lag can dang dang po rdzas gzhan du dam bca'i dam bca' de/ chos can gyi khyad par sel ba'i dam bca' yin zhes gsungs pa de yang gson cig 'o na/ de lta bu'i yan lag gsum pa de de lta bu'i yan lag can dang po dang rdzas gzhan ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa gang zhig dam bca' gnyis pa'i skabs su yan lag can rdzas gzhan la gnod pa ston zhes khyed rang gis bshad pa'i phyir/

'dod na/ yin par thal/ de de dang rdzas gzhan dang rdzas gcig gang rung gang zhig de dang rdzas gcig ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de gnyis ka rdzas su grub pa'i phyir/ phyi ma ma grub na/ yan lag dang yan lag rdzas gcig pa rang lugs la yang khas len rigs par thal lo/ /gal te de gnyis rdzas su ma grub bo zer na/ 'o na/ yan lag dang yan lag can gnyis kyang skabs su ma grub par thal lo/ /'dod na/ khyad par can min gzhan yod ni/ /sgrub na grub pa sgrub pa nyid/ /ces pa'i gzhung des/ lcid sogs chos gsum kyi khyad par du ma byas pa'i yan lag can/ yan lag las rdzas gzhan pa tsam sgrub na ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i ngor bsgrubs zin bsgrub par 'gyur zhes bstan pa la sel gnang rigs par thal lo/ /gal te smra bas phongs te/ de ni yan lag dang yan lag can gzhan yin pa tsam la dgongs kyi rdzas gzhan yin mi zer ro zer na/ 'o na khyod kyi yan lag dang yan lag can de/ bum pa dang bum pa'i yan lag byas kyi 'phrang nas 'jog gam/ 'dus ma byas nam mkha' dang 'gog pa sogs la 'jog phyi ma ni mi srid/ snga ma ltar na/ 'dus byas yin pas/ rdzas grub tu song ba de ka yin mod/ zhal 'dzum me bzhugs na mdzes pa legs so/ /yang paṇa shaka pa/ mngon sum gyi mthong rung gi khyad par du byas pa'i yan lag can chos can/ rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan du med de/ der yod na mngon sum la snang du rung ba las des ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad pa'ang / snga ma dang 'dra ste/ mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi yan lag can chos can/ khyod rang gi yan lag las rdzas gzhan yin par thal/ khyod de rdzas gcig dang rdzas tha dad gang rung yin/ phyi ma min pa'i phyir/ don dang mthun pa'i lan med do/ /des na go shaka la sogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag rags pa rdzas su ma grub ces pa mdo sde pa'i grub pa'i snying por 'chad pa'ang mi 'thad de/ 'dir/ khyad par can min gzhan yod ni/ /sogs kyis/

yan lag can dang yan lag rdzas gzhan rang lugs la zhal gyis bzhes 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na khyod rang la yang / mngon sum gyis mthong rung gi yan lag can gnyis pa chos can/ khyod rang gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran snang mi rung de dang rdzas gzhan yin par thal/ khyod de dang rdzas gzhan dang rdzas gcig gang rung yin/ khyod de dang rdzas gcig min pa'i phyir/ bskal ba'i bar du mtshungs so zer na/ gnad kyi snying por bshad par bya'i rna ba blags te nyon cig spyir tshur mthong mngon sum la snang mi rung gi rdul phran tsam zhig rang lugs la'ang khas len te/ dbang yul de phyir rdul phran min/ /zhes dang / shes de gcig la nges min phyir/ /zhes rdzas rdul phra rab rnams tshur mthong mngon sum gyis mi mthong bar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang yan lag can dang / de'i yan lag rnams ni/ rags pa kho na la 'jog pas/ tshul mthong mngon sum la snang ba zhig dgos te/ yan lag mngon sum ma yin par ni yan lag can mngon sum yin par rigs pa ma yin te/ yan lag can dang po bzhin no/ /zhes rgyan mkhan pos bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bye brag pas/ snang rung gi yan lag can gnyis pa dang / de'i yan lag rdul phran snang mi rung gnyis rdzas gzhan yin par khas blangs pa la skyon bstan pa yin pas/ yan lag can gnyis pa de/ spyir tshur mthong mngon sum la snang mi rung gi rdul phran dang rdzas gzhan yin yang / kho rang gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran dang rdzas gzhan ma yin te/ kho rang gi yan lag tu gyur pa'i rdul phran med pa'i phyir/ yan lag yin na/ rigs pa yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du tshur mthong mngon sum la snang mi rung gi rdul phran rnams/ yan lag can gzhan dang rdzas gzhan yin yang / kho rang gi yan lag can rags pa zhig dang rdzas gzhan ma yin te/ kho'i yan lag tu gyur pa'i rags pa med pa'i phyir/ kho rdul phran yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bye brag pas/

yan lag rdul phran snang du mi rung yang / yan lag can snang rung chos gsum ldan kho nar sgrub pa dang / nang pa yan lag dang yan lag can gnyis char tshur mthong la snang rung thogs bcas kho nar khas len pa'i gnad rtogs dgos so/ /gnad 'di rtogs na dka' ba'i 'phrang kun las rang grol du song ba yin no/ /'di yang kho bos rtogs so/ /de ltar yan lag rdzas 'gog gi rnam bshad gaṅgā'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal 'bum phrag gsum pa'i spyi ṭīka gi snying po bsdus/ rang gi rnam par dpyod pas kha bskangs te/ 'jam mgon blo gros rnam par rgyal pa'i zhabs rdul gtsug gis bstan pas/ rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la blo gros kyi snang ba cung zad gsal ba rigs pa smra ba klu sgrub ces bya bas/ dpal mnyan yod bya rgod gshongs kyi skyed tshal yangs par/ dbyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba 'bum phrag gsum pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun ring du 'phel zhing rgyas pa/ gaṅgā'i rgyun gyis rgya mtsho chen po bzhin du gyur cig/ //dge'o// bkra shis// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ yan lag rdzas 'gog gi rnam bshad gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
